LICENCE
======================================================================

Work Still Life with Cucumbers, Tomatoes and Vessels (Bodegon con pepinos, tomates y recipientes)
Author Luis Egidio Melendez
Year 1774
Holder Museo Nacional del Prado, Madrid
Source https://www.museodelprado.es/en/the-collection/art-work/ (artwork page for inv. P000930; the Prado blocks automated fetching, so the record was transcribed from the museum's own page by the user)
Accessed 2026-08-30

STATUS restricted-reproduction

Terms as stated by the holder:

Authorized download of the images for the following uses:
Private use
Academic, research, private studies and internal use in a regulated
education institution (schools, colleges and universities)
No profit publications with no comercial distribution, private websites,
private blogs and social media

Permits:
- private use
- academic and research use
- internal use in a regulated education institution
- no-profit publications with no commercial distribution
- private websites, blogs and social media

NOT ESTABLISHED -- do not assume:
- Whether this project's published site qualifies as a 'no profit publication with no commercial distribution'. That is a decision for the project, not for the acquisition worker. Until it is decided, treat as NOT cleared for publication.

Work status:
The painting itself (1774) is out of copyright. These terms attach to the Prado's PHOTOGRAPH of it.

Project policy: the licence of every work is respected. This file stays
with the work. If the work is copied or exported, copy this with it.
